datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions across Niger using the IPC framework. Geographic classifications were aggregated into spatial datasets representing different IPC scenarios for near-term projections in 2016.
